en: A place where you can sit; or to make someone sit down; or a position as a member of a parliament.
ex: Please take a seat and wait for the doctor.
請坐下等醫生。

en: A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute; or coming after the first; or to support a proposal.
ex: Wait a second; I will be right back.
等一下，我馬上回來。

en: A person whose job is to write letters, answer the phone and arrange meetings; or a senior government official.
ex: The secretary booked a meeting room for us.
秘書為我們預訂了一間會議室。

en: To notice something with your eyes; or to meet someone; or to understand something.
ex: I can see a mountain from my window.
我從窗戶可以看見一座山。

en: The small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant can grow.
ex: We planted some seeds in the garden in spring.
春天我們在花園裡種了一些種子。

en: To give something to someone in exchange for money.
ex: The shop sells fresh fruit and vegetables.
這家店賣新鮮水果和蔬菜。

en: To make something go from one place to another; or to cause someone to go somewhere.
ex: I sent a letter to my friend in Japan.
我寄了一封信給我在日本的朋友。

en: A group of words that makes a complete statement, beginning with a capital letter; or a punishment given by a judge.
ex: Please write a sentence using this new word.
請用這個新單字造一個句子。

en: Not joking; or thinking carefully about something; or very bad.
ex: The doctor looked serious when he spoke.
醫生說話時神情嚴肅。

en: The work done for customers in a shop, restaurant or hotel; or a system that provides something useful; or a religious ceremony.
ex: The service at this restaurant is very good.
這家餐廳的服務非常好。

en: A group of things that belong together; or to put something in a place; or to prepare something for use.
ex: Please set the table for dinner.
請擺好餐具準備吃晚餐。

en: More than two but not many; or separate and different.
ex: I have been to Japan several times.
我去過日本好幾次。

en: To move something quickly up and down or from side to side; or to tremble; or a movement of shaking.
ex: He shook my hand and said hello.
他和我握手並打招呼。

en: Used with 'I' or 'we' to talk about the future; or to make an offer or suggestion.
ex: Shall we go for a walk after dinner?
晚餐後我們要不要去散步？

en: The form or outline of something; or to give something a particular form.
ex: The cake was in the shape of a heart.
這個蛋糕是心形的。

en: To let others use or have part of something that belongs to you; or one part of something that is divided.
ex: The two sisters share a bedroom.
這兩姊妹共用一間臥室。

en: Having a thin edge or point that can cut easily; or quick and clever; or sudden.
ex: Be careful; the knife is very sharp.
小心，那把刀非常鋒利。

en: Used to talk about a woman or girl who has already been mentioned.
ex: She is my sister, and her name is Mary.
她是我姊姊，她的名字叫瑪麗。

en: A farm animal with thick wool that is kept for its meat, wool and milk.
ex: The farmer has more than one hundred sheep.
那位農夫有一百多隻羊。

en: A large boat that carries people or goods across the sea; or to send goods by sea or air.
ex: The ship sailed across the Pacific Ocean.
這艘船橫渡太平洋。

en: A piece of clothing that covers the upper part of your body with buttons down the front and sleeves.
ex: He wore a white shirt and a blue tie.
他穿著白襯衫和藍領帶。

en: Things worn on your feet, usually made of leather or cloth, that protect them.
ex: She bought a new pair of shoes for the trip.
她為旅行買了一雙新鞋。

en: A place where goods are sold; or to buy things in shops.
ex: I need to shop for a birthday present.
我需要去買生日禮物。

en: Not long in length or time; or not tall; or not enough.
ex: She has short hair and a happy smile.
她留著短髮，笑容很開朗。

en: Short pants that stop above the knees, worn in warm weather or when playing sports.
ex: He wore shorts and sandals to the beach.
他穿著短褲和涼鞋去海灘。

en: The part of the body between your neck and your arm; or to take on a responsibility.
ex: She carried a heavy bag on her shoulder.
她肩上扛著一個沉重的袋子。

en: To speak or call out very loudly; or a loud call.
ex: Don't shout; the baby is sleeping.
別大聲喊叫，寶寶在睡覺。

en: A performance on TV, radio or in a theater; or to let people see something; or to prove.
ex: She showed me the photos from her holiday.
她給我看了她假期的照片。

en: A device that sprays water over your body for washing; or a short period of rain; or to wash under it.
ex: I take a shower every morning before school.
我每天早上上學前淋浴。

en: Not well; suffering from an illness; or feeling that you want to vomit.
ex: She stayed home from school because she was sick.
她因為生病沒去上學。

en: A surface or edge of something; or one of two groups in a competition or disagreement.
ex: The post office is on the other side of the street.
郵局在街道的另一邊。

en: The ability to see; or something that you see; or a famous place for visitors.
ex: The sight of the sunset over the sea was amazing.
海上落日的景象令人驚嘆。

en: A notice with words or pictures that gives information; or to write your name; or a gesture.
ex: Please sign your name at the bottom of the page.
請在頁面底部簽名。

en: Easy to understand or do; or plain and not complicated.
ex: The instructions are simple and easy to follow.
說明書簡單易懂。

en: From a time in the past until now; or because.
ex: I have lived here since 2010.
我從2010年起就住在這裡。

en: To make musical sounds with your voice, usually with words.
ex: She likes to sing while she cooks.
她喜歡邊煮飯邊唱歌。

en: A person who sings, especially as a job.
ex: The singer performed her new song on stage.
那位歌手在舞台上表演了她的新歌。

en: A polite way of speaking to a man whose name you do not know; or a title for a knight.
ex: Excuse me, sir, where is the bus stop?
打擾一下，先生，公車站在哪裡？

en: A girl or woman who has the same parents as you; or a nun; or (British) a senior nurse.
ex: My sister is three years younger than me.
我妹妹比我小三歲。

en: To rest your weight on your bottom, with your back straight; or to take a test.
ex: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
請坐下，不要拘束。
